propositions: _paged_search loops forever when the DC server ignores/repeats startAt offsets instead of advancing, making 26+ calls against the harness cap rather than terminating
The only loop exit (if not batch: break) is unreachable because a startAt-ignoring server re-serves the same non-empty page indefinitely
get_parent_map's broad except Exception handler swallows any raised abort from _paged_search, converting it to a silent degraded {} return
All three DC whole-project readers feed fetch_snapshot behind three additional broad except Exception handlers that also swallow stall errors, leaving no surface boundary to abort loudly
The guard must raise on ANY repeated page (short or full), not just short pages, because DC's hardened jira.search.views.default.max caps every page below requested size by design
